digest.component_or_area: LLM code-review routing and trigger design
propositions: Rebar's concurrency-heavy workload generates high false-positive fire rates with committed-tier trigger vocabulary (13.3%) and requires a noisy tier (additional 22.0%) to catch load-bearing corpus bugs.
Project-level trigger vocabulary extensions must be documented and exemplified so other repos can adopt the two-layer design for their own domain-specific trigger patterns.

The committed high-precision tier and project noisy tier must merge correctly through the effective_routing path, demonstrated by a config-effect test that fires on project tokens absent from the committed list.
Fire-rate tradeoff and measurement methodology for the two-layer design (13.3% committed vs +22.0% noisy on rebar over 300 commits) must be documented with reproducible measurement steps.
